name: Jlesage Firefox
tagline: This project implements a Docker container for Firefox.
description: The GUI of the application is accessed through a modern web browser (no installation or configuration needed on the client side) or via any VNC client.

questions.label: Web port
questions.hint: The port on this server that opens the app.

questions.label: Vnc password
questions.hint: Generated automatically. Enter your own to replace it.

compose:
services:
  big-bear-jlesage-firefox:
    container_name: big-bear-jlesage-firefox # Name of the Docker container
    image: jlesage/firefox:v26.09.1@sha256:302aa068dcfa46a2d248771c998f67377383554df8940252caef42b99c13eb65 # Docker image for the Firefox browser
    ports:
      - "${APP_PORT}:5800" # Expose port 5800 for VNC access
    environment:
      - VNC_PASSWORD=${SECRET_VNC_PASSWORD} # Set the VNC password to 'casaos'
      - FF_OPEN_URL=https://community.bigbeartechworld.com/ # Set the default URL to Big Bear Tech World
    volumes:
      - ${APP_DATA_DIR}/config:/config:rw # Mount the host directory to the container's Downloads directory
